title: Exponential Contraction for Underdamped Langevin Diffusions with Superlinear Forces
summary: We establish exponential contraction for underdamped Langevin diffusions with nonconvex confining potentials and possibly superlinear forces. The force satisfies a polynomial local Lipschitz bound with exponent $\ell\geq0$, and the potential has a lower bound of order $m\geq2$, with $3\ell<2m$. Under radial confinement and a potential--dissipation inequality, we construct an explicit weighted Kantorovich transportation cost in which the Markov semigroup contracts probability laws exponentially.
